objective_pt: Falar de problemas ambientais e de atitudes do dia a dia (reciclar, economizar água), dar opinião e usar o primeiro condicional: "If we don't..., we'll...".

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer falando do que a pessoa faz pelo meio ambiente.
prompts: What do you do to help the environment?
watchFor: Dizer "the nature"; em geral, "nature" vai sem artigo.
Usar "the environment" sem o artigo; aqui ele é obrigatório: "protect the environment".

exercises.prompt: What do you do to protect the environment?
accepted: What do you do to protect the environment
What do you do to help the environment

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você recicla e tenta usar menos plástico.
exercises.listen: Do you do anything to help the environment?
accepted: I recycle and I try to use less plastic
Yes, I recycle and I try to use less plastic
I recycle and try to use less plastic
Yes, I recycle and try to use less plastic
I recycle, and I try not to use too much plastic
Yeah, I recycle and I avoid plastic

commonErrors.correction_en: I recycle and I try to use less plastic.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "try" vem "to" + verbo: "try to use".
commonErrors.correction_en: I recycle and I try to use less plastic.

exercises.explanation_pt: No sentido geral, "nature" vai sem artigo: "I love nature". O português usa "a natureza", o inglês não.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender vocabulário de problemas e soluções ambientais.
prompts: What's the biggest environmental problem in Brazil?
Is pollution a problem in your city?
watchFor: Dizer "garbage" e "trash" está ok (EUA); "rubbish" é britânico; "lixo" não é "lux".

exercises.example_en: Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.
We shouldn't waste so much water.
Climate change is making summers hotter every year.
Deforestation in the Amazon affects the whole planet.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "A gente desperdiça muita comida."
accepted: We waste a lot of food
We waste so much food
We waste too much food
We waste lots of food
People waste a lot of food

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "A gente" é "we". "The people" quer dizer "o povo" ou "aquelas pessoas".
commonErrors.correction_en: We waste a lot of food.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Food" é incontável: "a lot of food" ou "much food", e não "many food".
commonErrors.correction_en: We waste a lot of food.

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar "environment" (o "n" do meio aparece pouco), "climate" e "recycle".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. A força está em en-VI-ron-ment e KLAI-mit.
exercises.prompt: The environment and the climate are changing fast.
accepted: The environment and the climate are changing fast
The environment and the climate are changing quickly

exercises.prompt: We recycle paper, glass, and plastic.
accepted: We recycle paper, glass, and plastic

exercises.explanation_pt: "Climate" é KLAI-mit: força na primeira sílaba e o final bem curto.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender opiniões sobre o meio ambiente e responder com o primeiro condicional.
prompts: What will happen if we don't stop deforestation?
watchFor: Usar "will" nas duas partes: "If we will recycle, we will..."; depois de "if" vem o presente.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha a opinião da pessoa.
exercises.listen: I think banning plastic bags is a good start, but it won't solve the problem on its own.
options: Proibir sacolas plásticas resolve o problema.
É um bom começo, mas sozinho não resolve.
Proibir sacolas é uma má ideia.
exercises.explanation_pt: "A good start" = um bom começo; "it won't solve the problem on its own" = não vai resolver sozinho.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda com o primeiro condicional: o planeta vai ficar mais quente.
exercises.listen: What will happen if we don't reduce pollution?
accepted: The planet will get hotter
If we don't reduce pollution, the planet will get hotter
The planet will get warmer
It will get hotter
The planet's going to get hotter
The planet is going to get hotter
The Earth will get hotter

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "if" use o presente: "If we don't reduce pollution, the planet will get hotter".
commonErrors.correction_en: If we don't reduce pollution, the planet will get hotter.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que concorda, porque o plástico leva centenas de anos para se decompor.
exercises.listen: Do you think we should ban single-use plastic?
accepted: Yes, because plastic takes hundreds of years to break down
Yes, I do, because plastic takes hundreds of years to break down
Yes, because it takes hundreds of years to break down
I agree, because plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose
Yes, because plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose
Yes, I think so. Plastic takes hundreds of years to break down

commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, because plastic takes hundreds of years to break down.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Levar tempo" é "take": "it takes hundreds of years".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, because plastic takes hundreds of years to break down.

teacher.goal_pt: Discutir problemas ambientais: causas, consequências e o que cada um pode fazer.
prompts: Whose responsibility is it to protect the environment: governments or people?
What will your city be like in 2050?
watchFor: Falar só em termos gerais; incentive exemplos concretos da cidade da pessoa.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Se todo mundo reciclar, vai ter menos lixo nas ruas."
accepted: If everyone recycles, there will be less trash on the streets
If everybody recycles, there will be less trash on the streets
If everyone recycles, there'll be less trash on the streets
If everyone recycles, there will be less garbage on the streets
If everyone recycles, there will be less rubbish in the streets
If everyone recycles, there will be less trash in the streets
If everyone recycles, there's going to be less trash on the streets

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Everyone" é singular e, depois de "if", vai no presente: "If everyone recycles".
commonErrors.correction_en: If everyone recycles, there will be less trash on the streets.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Vai ter" no sentido de existir é "there will be", e não "will have".
commonErrors.correction_en: If everyone recycles, there will be less trash on the streets.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu tento tomar banhos mais curtos."
accepted: I try to take shorter showers
I try to have shorter showers
I try to take short showers
I try to take quicker showers
I try to shower faster

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Banho de chuveiro é "shower". "Bath" é banho de banheira.
commonErrors.correction_en: I try to take shorter showers.
I try to take shorter showers.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: We need to use more renewable energy.

exercises.instruction_pt: Dê a sua opinião sobre um problema ambiental.
exercises.prompt_en: What do you think is the biggest environmental problem today, and what can ordinary people do about it?
guidelines_pt: Diga qual é o problema e por quê: "I think the biggest problem is... because...".
Use o primeiro condicional: "If we don't..., ...will...".
Dê duas atitudes concretas do dia a dia: "People could...", "I try to...".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar o primeiro condicional, "nature" sem artigo e "waste".
prompts: What will happen if it doesn't rain this month?
What do people waste the most?

exercises.prompt: If we don't act now, it'll be too late.
accepted: If we don't act now, it'll be too late
If we do not act now, it will be too late
If we don't act now, it will be too late
Don't waste water
Do not waste water
Please don't waste water
Try not to waste water

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O imperativo negativo usa "Don't": "Don't waste water".
Água em geral vai sem artigo: "Don't waste water".

options: If it will rain, we'll stay home.
If it rains, we'll stay home.
If it rains, we stay home tomorrow.
exercises.explanation_pt: Primeiro condicional: "if" + presente, e "will" na outra parte.

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete com a forma certa de "cut".
exercises.sentence: If they ___ down more trees, the animals will lose their homes.
accepted: cut

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "if" vem o presente, e "they" não leva "s": "If they cut".
commonErrors.correction_en: If they cut down more trees, the animals will lose their homes.
